annotations.title: Cumulative inflation in Poland between two months or years (CPI, GUS)

description: Use for cumulative inflation in Poland: how much prices rose in total from one year or month to another, e.g. since 2020 or from 2022 to 2026. For the latest monthly CPI reading, use get_macro_indicator. For the purchasing power of an amount, give the cumulative inflation from this tool. How much consumer prices in Poland rose in total between two months or years, from the chain of GUS consumer price indices since 1982: December on December for full years (as in the GUS yearly table) and month-on-month indices within a year. "From 2022" means from January 2022; "to 2026" means to December or to the latest published month. Gives the cumulative inflation in %, how many times prices rose, the average per year and the number of months. Without from: cumulative inflation from the start of each recent year to the latest month and the December-on-December inflation of recent years.

from.description: Start: YYYY (from January) or YYYY-MM, e.g. 2022 or 2023-05.

to.description: End: YYYY (to December or the latest month) or YYYY-MM; default the latest published month.

years.description: Number of recent years in the summary tables, default 10.

name: get_cumulative_inflation
